notfound_text: The address may be wrong or the page was moved.
rooterror_title: We could not show this page
sidebar_challenge: TexVitrus challenge · data from Vitrus Ambiente
auth_aside_title: Textile collection, designed at the lowest cost.
auth_aside_text: From bag to yarn: plan the network, decide in plain language, follow every lot to industry and hand the municipality its 2028 dossier.
auth_footer: © 2026 Novelo · Hélder Gonçalves and Flávio Fernandes
login_remember: Keep me signed in on this device
login_error_google_failed: Could not sign in with Google. Try again.
login_error_generic: Could not sign in. Try again.
register_subtitle: It takes a minute. All you need is an email.
register_closed_text: Ask the Novelo team for access or sign in with an existing account.
forgot_subtitle: Enter your account email and we will send you a link to create a new password.
forgot_sent_text: If an account exists for {email}, we sent a link to reset your password. The link expires in 60 minutes.
reset_subtitle: Choose a password you do not use anywhere else.
reset_success: Password reset. You can now sign in.
reset_invalid_text: The recovery link is incomplete. Request a new one.
verify_error_text: {reason} Sign in and request a new link.
verify_banner_text: Confirm your email {email} to protect your account.
verify_resend_toast: We sent a new link to {email}.
validation_password_spaces: No spaces at the start or end
account_profile_description: Your name appears in the menu and in emails.
account_language_description: Used in the interface and in the emails we send you.
account_sessions_description: If you lost a device or suspect unauthorised access, sign out everywhere.
account_password_change_description: Changing it signs you out on all devices.
account_password_set_description: Your account signs in with Google. Set a password to also sign in with email.
account_password_changed: Password changed. Sign in again with the new password.
error_validation_error: Some data is not valid. Check the fields and try again.
error_session_expired: Your session expired. Sign in again.
error_account_inactive: This account is deactivated. Contact an administrator.
error_invalid_token: The link is invalid or has expired. Request a new one.
error_forbidden: You do not have permission for this action.
error_registration_closed: Registration is closed. Ask the team for access.
error_not_found: We could not find what you were looking for.
error_email_taken: An account with this email already exists.
error_cannot_modify_self: You cannot change your own role or status.
error_rate_limited: Too many attempts. Try again in a few minutes.
error_feature_disabled: This feature is not available right now.
error_upstream_error: An external service failed. Try again shortly.
error_internal_error: Internal error. We have been notified; try again.
error_network: Cannot reach the server. Check your internet connection.
baseline_description: What is already collected, where it goes and how much is still to capture among {population} inhabitants.
stat_vs_potential_hint: of {tonnes} per year (0.7 kg/inhab/month, municipal plan)
stat_to_capture_hint: the margin a new network can go after
section_gap_description: The filled part is what is already collected, split by destination. The hatched area is the potential still to capture.
section_flows_description: Flow observed in {year}, by organisation and final destination. It is the same view Novelo uses to compare scenarios.
section_waste_description: Municipal waste composition in Portugal ({kg} kg per inhabitant per year). Sanitary textiles are not part of textile collection.
sankey_aria: Textile flow by organisation and destination, in tonnes
insight_reuse_body: {part} of {total}. Revenue and impact grow when more textile arrives clean and reusable.
insight_biggest_body: {tonnes} in {year}. A new network has to decide whether to complement or replace these circuits.
insight_reject_body: Only {tonnes} collected, so the sample is small. Worth confirming before drawing conclusions.
insight_estimated_body: {entities} use report percentages applied to the total. They are marked as estimates.
circuits_description: The routes that already serve each locality are the basis of on-demand textile collection: where a truck already goes, the extra kilometre costs almost nothing.
circuits_stat_vehicles_hint: {count} never have a circuit (reserve or workshop)
circuits_stat_notes_hint: circuits with a note in the data
circuits_empty_text: Run the seed to import the Vitrus data.
fleet_description: How many vehicles and people Vitrus puts on the street each shift. It is capacity already paid for, where textile collection can fit.
fleet_stat_multi_hint: vehicles that change stream on the same day
fleet_heatmap_description: Number of circuits served per typology in each shift.
fleet_vehicles_description: Plates and what each one does. Those that never have a circuit are free capacity.
fleet_flag_idle_hint: Appears in the planning but never with a circuit: reserve or workshop?
fleet_flag_multi_hint: Serves more than one stream: the body needs washing between streams.
localities_description: Each locality with its circuits, collection type and the days a truck already goes there. Where one passes almost every day, on-demand textile collection needs no new kilometres.
localities_stat_none_hint: circuit without a schedule in the data
quality_description: Where each number comes from and what we still need to confirm with Vitrus. Nothing is silently fixed: every doubt stays here until someone resolves it.
users_description: Who has access to Novelo and with which role. Deactivating an account ends its sessions immediately.
validation_number_positive: Enter a value greater than zero
mode_street_hint: Container on the public road, where density justifies it. Needs investment and fixed collections.
mode_existing_hint: Point at parish councils, schools, supermarkets or recycling centres. Almost no investment.
mode_on_demand_hint: Residents request it and a vehicle collects, using circuits that already pass. No investment.
objective_max_tonnes_hint: Captures as much textile as possible without exceeding the annual budget.
objective_min_cost_hint: Meets a capture target at the lowest annual cost.
map_description: Parishes with Census 2021 population and estimated textile demand, and the localities Vitrus already serves.
map_panel_empty: Click a parish to see its details.
map_panel_no_service: No circuit identified in the data.
map_containers_note: Container locations arrive on 20 October and will appear here as a new layer.
sim_description: Pick a budget or a target and Novelo decides, parish by parish, the cheapest collection mode and plans the routes.
sim_budget_hint: Maximum total annual cost: {value} (annualised capex + operations).
sim_target_hint: {tonnes} per year, out of a potential of {potential}.
sim_running_hint: The optimiser can take up to half a minute.
sim_assumptions_description: Each number shows where it comes from: real Vitrus data, the municipal plan or an assumption still to validate. Values changed here only apply to this scenario.
sim_constraints_help: Optional. Limits the collection modes allowed in a parish, for example on-demand only in a scattered area.
assumptions_description: The numbers behind every scenario. Real data already feeds the model; unit costs remain assumptions until Vitrus validates them.
assumptions_readonly: Only administrators can change the assumptions. You can adjust them per scenario in the simulator.
param_piggyback_extra_km: Detour when a circuit already passes
param_piggyback_min_days: Circuit days needed to reuse the route
scenarios_description: Every computed scenario, ready to compare in euros, tonnes and €/t.
scenarios_empty_text: Compute the first one in the simulator: pick a budget and Novelo designs the network.
scenarios_compare_hint: Pick two scenarios to compare them side by side.
scenario_infeasible_text: Not even with every mode available does it reach the capture target. Lower the target or relax constraints and compute again.
scenario_description: Optimiser result with the assumptions stored below. Projected values are estimates.
scenario_rename_description: The name appears in the list and in comparisons.
scenario_delete_description: The scenario and its results are deleted. This cannot be undone.
scenario_map_description: The mode chosen in each parish and the collection routes from the depot.
scenario_map_aria: Scenario map with the collection mode per parish
scenario_modes_description: The mix of modes is where the savings are: not every parish deserves the same treatment.
scenario_flows_description: Tonnes by parish, mode and destination, using the destination split observed in 2025.
scenario_routes_description: One round per mode, computed with the vehicles' capacity.
scenario_params_description: The scenario keeps a copy of the assumptions: it is reproducible even if the active assumptions change.
kpi_km_hint: routes and requests, including road detour
route_none: No routes: this scenario uses on-demand pickup only.
compare_description: Two scenarios side by side, with the difference in every number. Green is better, red is worse.
compare_note: Values projected by the model: estimates based on each scenario's assumptions.
compare_empty_text: Select scenario A and scenario B to see the comparison.
error_conflict: This action is not possible in the current state.
triage_description: Photograph the garment and its label: Novelo suggests condition, composition and brand. You confirm and the item joins the lot.
triage_open_text: Every sorted item joins a lot with a QR code. Continue an open lot or open a new one at the collection point.
triage_privacy: Photos are deleted after analysis. Only brand, composition, condition and weight are kept.
triage_ai_off_text: The OpenRouter key is missing on the server. Set OPENROUTER_API_KEY and try again.
triage_suggestion: Model suggestion: confirm or correct it.
triage_low_confidence: The model is not sure: check carefully.
triage_weight_hint: Estimated from the garment type; in the pilot it comes from a scale.
lots_description: Every lot has a QR code and a public passport. When it closes, it enters the fibre exchange for recyclers.
lots_empty_text: Do the first sorting: open a lot and photograph the items.
lot_description: Internal lot passport: items, composition, weight and history.
lot_stat_destination_hint: reuse {reuse} kg · recycling {recycle} kg · reject {reject} kg
lot_items_empty: This lot has no items yet.
passport_composition_note: Composition read from labels and weighted by item weight.
passport_privacy: This page holds no personal data. Photos are not stored.
passport_not_found_text: There is no lot with code {code}.
market_description: Sorted lots grouped by fibre, for recyclers in the Ave Valley. Clean, homogeneous textile is what the market is missing.
market_empty_text: Close a lot in sorting for it to appear here.
market_reserve_description: Record the interested recycler. No prices or payments: the value lies in making the material visible.
brands_description: Kilos and composition by brand, from sorted items. It gives the municipality its own data for the EPR discussion instead of European averages.
brands_small_sample: The sample has fewer than {min} items: do not draw conclusions by brand until there is more sorting.
brands_empty_text: Brands appear when sorted items have a visible label.
brands_privacy: Only brand, composition, condition and weight are stored. There is never any data about who handed the item in.
whatif_description: Ask in plain language. The AI understands the question, you confirm, the optimiser computes and a verifier makes sure every number in the explanation exists in the results.
whatif_placeholder: E.g. What if we remove street containers from Serzedelo and switch to on-demand pickup?
whatif_example_1: What if Serzedelo moves to on-demand pickup?
whatif_example_2: What if the budget is €20,000 per year?
whatif_example_3: What if street containers capture 20% more?
whatif_ai_off_text: The OpenRouter key is missing on the server. Set OPENROUTER_API_KEY and try again.
whatif_unknown_parishes: I could not find these parishes: {names}.
whatif_nothing_to_apply: I could not turn the question into a change. Try to be more specific.
whatif_unverified: Automatic text: the model failed verification
reports_description: A PDF for the municipality to negotiate with producer responsibility organisations: cost per tonne by type of territory, material collected, brand evidence, method and sources.
reports_pick_hint: The report compares the chosen scenarios and uses the assumptions stored in each.
reports_no_scenarios_title: You need at least one scenario
reports_no_scenarios_text: The report is based on scenarios computed in the simulator.
reports_history_empty: You have not generated any report yet.
offline_banner: No internet connection. Data already open stays visible; the rest returns when the network is back.
table_no_results_hint: Try other terms or clear the filters.
error_ai_budget_exceeded: The monthly AI budget has been reached. An admin can raise it under Administration · AI.
copilot_description: Ask in plain language. Numbers always come from the optimiser, never from the model.
copilot_empty_description: I simulate scenarios, compare options and read network coverage using the real Vitrus data.
copilot_suggestion_simulate: Simulate a scenario with 60 thousand euros a year
copilot_suggestion_compare: Compare the current scenario with the French benchmark
copilot_suggestion_coverage: Where is the biggest coverage gap?
copilot_hint: Enter sends · Shift+Enter for a new line
copilot_unverified: Numbers not verified: only the cards count
copilot_context_scenario: The conversation takes the open scenario into account.
quality_alerts_description: Each doubt stays here until someone resolves it. The AI suggests, you confirm.
quality_sources_description: The Vitrus files behind every number, with reception date and fingerprint.
quality_alerts_empty_description: Try another status or type to see the rest.
cov_description: How much of the population lives within walking distance of a textile container, parish by parish, and how many points are missing against a reference network.
cov_stat_covered_hint: {count} residents within {radius} m of a container.
cov_stat_containers_hint: {total} imported, of every type and status.
cov_stat_gap_hint: Points missing against the reference of {points}.
cov_stat_parishes_hint: Each one will get its own coverage.
cov_reference_text: {name}: 1 point for every {people} residents gives the municipality {points} points.
cov_reference_unverified_note: This figure still has to be confirmed at the source before it is quoted.
cov_awaiting_text: Vitrus delivers the coordinates of every container on that date. Until then there is no coverage to compute, and we prefer not to make it up. This is not an error.
cov_awaiting_known_text: The population of each parish (INE) and the points the benchmark would give each one. The map and table show that.
cov_awaiting_next_1: The share of the population within walking distance of a container, at 200, 300 or 500 m.
cov_awaiting_next_2: Containers per 1,000 residents in each parish.
cov_awaiting_next_3: The point gap against the benchmark and the parishes where it weighs most.
cov_awaiting_next_4: The containers as a layer on the network map.
cov_table_description_ok: Estimate at {radius} m in a straight line. Sort by coverage to see where to start.
cov_table_description_waiting: Population and reference points by parish. Coverage arrives with the containers.
cov_table_empty_text: The parish list comes from INE. Run the ETL to load it.
cov_method_estimate: Coverage is an estimate, not a measurement.
cov_method_radius: Straight-line distance, not walking distance. The real pedestrian network gives lower values.
mapc_layer_empty: No containers imported. They arrive on 20 October 2026.
mapc_metric_coverage_off: Coverage appears once there are containers.
aiadm_description: Costs, models per feature, limits and triage quality. Visible to administrators only.
aiadm_task_copilot_desc: Answers free-form questions using tools over the data and scenarios.
aiadm_task_whatif_desc: Turns a plain-language question into a scenario change.
aiadm_task_explain_desc: Explains a scenario's results, with verified numbers.
aiadm_task_briefing_desc: Writes the executive summary of the RAP report.
aiadm_task_alert_resolution_desc: Suggests how to resolve each data quality alert.
aiadm_task_triage_desc: Analyses a garment photo: type, condition, brand and composition.
aiadm_credits_unavailable_hint: OpenRouter did not return the balance. Without a key, AI features are off.
aiadm_credits_error: OpenRouter could not be reached right now. The rest of the panel still works.
aiadm_budget_desc: Accumulated cost against the set limit.
aiadm_chart_desc: Daily AI spend, in US dollars.
aiadm_chart_label: Bar chart of daily AI cost
aiadm_usage_empty_desc: Once someone uses the copilot, What if or triage, the cost shows up here.
aiadm_by_task_desc: How much each feature spent in the period.
aiadm_by_model_desc: Cost, latency and errors of each model used.
aiadm_picker_desc: Pick a model from the OpenRouter catalogue, test it and save.
aiadm_picker_empty_desc: Try another search. Only models with the required capabilities are listed.
aiadm_picker_stale: The OpenRouter catalogue did not respond: showing the previous copy.
aiadm_tokens_invalid: Enter a whole number of at least 64, or leave empty.
aiadm_budget_invalid: Enter an amount in US dollars of 0 or more, or leave empty.
aiadm_limits_budget_desc: When spending reaches the limit, AI features stop responding until next month.
aiadm_limits_budget_placeholder: Empty inherits .env; 0 turns the limit off
aiadm_limits_defaults_desc: Apply to every task without its own values. Empty fields inherit from .env.
aiadm_limits_fallback_hint: Used when the main model fails or is unavailable.
aiadm_eval_empty_desc: Run the evaluation from the project root to compare models on real photos.
aiadm_eval_desc: Accuracy per field (0% to 100%), cost per piece and latency of each model.
scn_anchor_budget: With {budget} a year, the network collects {tonnes} of textiles ({share} of the {potential} potential) at {eurT}.
scn_anchor_target: To collect {target} a year, the minimum cost is {cost} a year: the network collects {tonnes} at {eurT}.
scn_anchor_note: Model estimate on the Vitrus data: {baseline} a year are collected today. The numbers come from the optimiser, not from AI.
sens_controls_description: We vary each assumption up and down and measure how much the result changes.
sens_threshold_hint: Optional: computes the probability of staying below it.
sens_unsupported_alert_title: {n} of the {total} biggest uncertainty drivers are assumptions without Vitrus data
sens_unsupported_alert_text: The higher this number, the more the result depends on team guesses rather than measured data. These are the assumptions to validate first.
sens_tornado_description: Effect of each assumption on cost per tonne when it varies ±{swing}%, largest first.
sens_tornado_aria: Tornado chart: impact on cost per tonne of each assumption at ±{swing}%
sens_no_base: This scenario has no reference cost per tonne.
sens_range_description: Across {n} draws of all assumptions, 8 in 10 results fall between P10 and P90.
rob_description: Is scenario A still better than B if the assumptions are wrong?
rob_statement: In {share} of the samples, {a} is better than {b} on {criterion}.
rob_progress: Share of samples in which A is better
rob_threshold: Criterion: better in at least {value} of the samples
bench_description: Targets from other systems, checked against what the Guimarães network can reach with the current assumptions.
bench_empty_text: No external targets are configured yet.
bench_params: Target of {kg} kg per inhabitant per year, with 1 {mode} point per {people} inhabitants (today: 1 per {current}).
bench_scale_aria: Scale in tonnes per year: collected today {observed}, model ceiling {ceiling}, target {target}.
bench_reachable_text: The target fits within the model ceiling, with {margin} to spare. The minimum cost to get there is calculated when the scenario is created.
bench_unreachable_text: The target requires collecting {capture} of the textiles generated and is {shortfall} above the model ceiling. With these assumptions no budget gets there.
bench_dialog_description: The scenario uses the target of {target} a year and the reference scenario's point density.
bench_dialog_unreachable_title: The target is out of reach
bench_dialog_unreachable_text: The {target} target exceeds the {ceiling} ceiling. Instead of the minimum cost, compute the most tonnes a budget can collect.
bench_objective_min_cost: Only possible if the target fits within the model ceiling.
bench_objective_max_tonnes: How much is collected with the budget you set.
pilot_description: The parishes to test first: those that teach the most about the network, with the numbers we will measure.
pilot_form_description: Change the parameters and the result updates.
pilot_floor_hint: Empty: calculated to measure the reject rate accurately.
pilot_error_range: Enter a whole number between {min} and {max}
pilot_empty_text: No combination meets these parameters. Lower the signal floor or add modes.
pilot_startup_hint: Investment and operation of {k} parishes over {months} months
pilot_zones_description: Every number has its source; open "Facts and sources" to see it.
pilot_score_description: How much this set of parishes teaches, from 0 to 1, across four criteria.
pilot_score_note: The weights are a team assumption, not data.
pilot_floor_description: Minimum tonnes for the pilot to measure the reject rate accurately.
pilot_floor_met: The chosen pilot reaches the signal floor.
pilot_floor_not_met_text: The combination with the most tonnes was returned, but the pilot will not measure the reject rate that accurately.
pilot_floor_calc: The floor calculation, step by step
sim_step_objective_text: What you want to optimise, and with which budget or target.
sim_step_modes_text: The three channels the optimiser combines, with the current assumption values.
sim_step_constraints_text: Optional: limit the modes allowed in a parish.
sim_summary_errors: Fix the highlighted fields to calculate.
rw_circuits_description: The routes that already serve each locality: where a truck already runs, on-demand textile collection needs almost no new kilometres.
rw_localities_description: Circuits, collection type and the days a truck already passes through each locality.
rw_fleet_description: Vehicles and people Vitrus puts on the road in each shift: capacity already paid for, where textile collection can fit in.
rw_lots_description: Every lot has a QR code and a public passport. When it closes, it joins the fibre exchange.
rw_market_description: Sorted lots, grouped by fibre, for recyclers in the Ave valley.
rw_brands_description: Kilos and composition by brand from sorted items: local data for the EPR discussion.
rw_brands_stat_top_hint: of the weight in the top {count} brands
rw_reports_description: A PDF for the municipality to negotiate with producer responsibility organisations: cost per tonne, material collected, brand evidence, method and sources.
rw_triage_description: Photograph the garment and its label, confirm Novelo's suggestion and the item joins the lot.
rw_triage_continue_text: Pick up a lot that is still receiving items.
rw_assumptions_description: The numbers behind every scenario, each with its source. Unit costs stay assumptions until Vitrus validates them.
cov_reference_rule: 1 point for every {people} residents gives the municipality {points} points.
